items.name: Business Plan 2025-2029 investment portfolio
items.claim: Petrobras' Board of Directors approved the Business Plan 2025-29 (BP 2025-29) forecasting investments of US$ 111 billion, with US$ 98 billion in the portfolio of projects under implementation and US$ 13 billion in the portfolio of projects under evaluation.
items.source_excerpt: On the BP 2025-29 horizon, Petrobras forecasts investments of US$ 111 billion, with US$ 98 billion in the portfolio of projects under implementation and US$ 13 billion in the portfolio of projects under evaluation, consisting of opportunities with a lower degree of maturity and subject to additional financing studies before the execution begins.
